Attack ClearBasicExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Deals 350% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 90% chance to reduce their ATK by 40% for 2 turns. Afterward, grants self 1 layer of [Softness].
Rune Necklace Lv.2When Attack Clear, Cut-off Support and Turnaround deal DMG to any enemies, there is an 80% chance to inflict [Provoke] on them for 1 turn.
Rune Necklace Lv.3Attack Clear, Cut-off Support and Turnaround can be enhanced when self has 1 layer of [Softness], [Cut], and [Rage] correspondingly, with a 50% chance not to consume any layer of [Softness], [Cut], and [Rage].
Cut-off SupportActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Removes 1 layer of buff at random from an enemy target and deals 330% DEF DMG to the target, with a 90% chance to inflict [Block Buff] on them for 1 turn. Afterward, grants self 1 layer of [Cut].
Rune Necklace Lv.2When Attack Clear, Cut-off Support and Turnaround deal DMG to any enemies, there is an 80% chance to inflict [Provoke] on them for 1 turn.
Rune Necklace Lv.3Attack Clear, Cut-off Support and Turnaround can be enhanced when self has 1 layer of [Softness], [Cut], and [Rage] correspondingly, with a 50% chance not to consume any layer of [Softness], [Cut], and [Rage].
TurnaroundActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Increases self DEF by 60% for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 2 stages of 390% DEF DMG each to a single enemy and grants self 1 layer of [Rage].
Rune Necklace Lv.2When Attack Clear, Cut-off Support and Turnaround deal DMG to any enemies, there is an 80% chance to inflict [Provoke] on them for 1 turn.
Rune Necklace Lv.3Attack Clear, Cut-off Support and Turnaround can be enhanced when self has 1 layer of [Softness], [Cut], and [Rage] correspondingly, with a 50% chance not to consume any layer of [Softness], [Cut], and [Rage].
FearlessnessPassiveExclusive Lv.1
Will is immune to [Silence], [Horrify], and [Provoke] and all self skills' CD cannot be increased; Grants self a [Shield] by 18% of self Max HP for 1 turn at the beginning of each wave or at the end of each turn; Grants self 2 layers of [Softness], [Cut], and [Rage] at the beginning of each wave. Meanwhile, Attack Clear, Cut-off Support and Turnaround will be enhanced when self has 2 layers of [Softness], [Cut], and [Rage] correspondingly; [Softness] is granted when self releases counterattacks and pursue-and-attacks.
Rune Necklace Lv.1Will cannot take Crits and is immune to DoT when he has a [Shield].
